verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships OpenCode and Claude Code as default agent harnesses and prompts you to set up a default agent on first boot to 'put it to work on your computer'. It also wires the agent into the system: crash notifications hand the dump to the agent for diagnosis, bundled skills let it build apps, plugins and themes, and the omarchy CLI is designed for agent-driven configuration. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent integration, depth beyond one-line marketing claims, and clarity that the assistants are third-party harnesses requiring your own sign-in/account rather than a native Omarchy assistant.
